title: Regional launch gate checklist and compatibility matrix for new model additions
creator: Sofia Nguyen
description: This ticket defines the launch gates, compatibility matrix, and cross-team checklist for adding new model variants to the Redwood Model Catalog with regional/localized support. Focus areas: per-locale benchmark thresholds, docs & examples localized, release notes and comms cadence, legal/PD/Privacy checks, console metadata, and telemetry requirements for post-launch quality monitoring.
acceptance_criteria: Model entry added to catalog with metadata (region tags, quantization variant, size, latency profile)
Benchmarks uploaded for English and top 3 localized locales and meet minimum thresholds defined in this ticket
Console product page and sample prompts updated with localized examples for each locale being launched
Release notes draft reviewed by PM, Developer Experience, and Legal; sign-off logged in ticket
Rollout plan with gating conditions (canary %, fallback model) created and scheduled in Redwood Console
Telemetry hooks are in place: quality metrics, latency percentiles by region, and alerting thresholds configured
tasks: PM: finalize locale list and pass to Benchmarks team (Sofia)
Benchmarks: run evaluation harness for en-US, es-ES, fr-FR, ja-JP on latency and accuracy (assigned: Priya Rao)
Docs: create localized quickstarts and update model spec page (assigned: Marco Diaz)
DevEx/SDK: verify SDK examples call correct model alias and include fallback logic; publish small sample PR (assigned: Lina Park)
Console: add region tags, model icons, and rollout policy template (assigned: EngOps)
Legal & Privacy: confirm training data regional constraints and export controls are acceptable (assigned: Arun Mehta)
Comms: draft release notes and product announcement assets; schedule blog and newsletter windows (assigned: Communications)
SRE/Infra: create canary pool for target region and validate autoscale behavior under synthetic load (assigned: Mateo Ruiz)
Post-launch: define quality regression monitor set and incident runbook (SRE/Quality)
PM: finalize go/no-go checklist 24 hours before rollout and update this ticket with approvals
rollout_schedule: Phase 1: en-US canary 5% on 2026-03-22; Phase 2: expand to en-US 50% and es-ES canary 5% on 2026-03-24; Phase 3: full regional ramp and deprecation of legacy alias on 2026-03-25
benchmarks_requirements: Minimum pass criteria: token-level perplexity within 5% of baseline for each locale; 95th percentile latency under 220ms for n=1024 batch emulation in dedicated environment; CTR/QoE synthetic prompts above threshold defined in docs:benchmark-v1
docs_and_examples: Localized quickstarts: 3 short examples per locale; API snippet with language tag and deterministic seed; example prompts vetted for cultural sensitivity; translation files stored in Drive->Docs/ModelCatalog/Localized/<model-name>
release_notes_draft:
New model variant: model-XYZ-2026-03
- Summary: Smaller, optimized variant of model-XYZ with improved latency for short conversational contexts.
- Notable changes: Quantized INT8 runtime profile, trimmed tokenization for improved throughput.
- Locales: en-US (GA), es-ES (canary), fr-FR (canary), ja-JP (beta).
- Known limitations: Slight drop in long-context coherence vs model-XYZ-base; fallback recommended for threads > 2k tokens.
- Migration notes: Use alias 'model-XYZ:fast-2026-03' to opt-in.
communication_plan: Internal: Cross-functional demo on 2026-03-20; go/no-go email 24h prior to rollout. External: staged blog post (approx 500 words) + release notes page; targeted outreach to top 20 customers using model-XYZ; update SDK changelog. Social: LinkedIn/Twitter announcement on full GA. Support: KB article and troubleshooting guide published day of launch.
legal_privacy_checklist: Confirm training data jurisdictions and any restrictions
Data retention and telemetry opt-out paths documented
Customer-facing privacy blurb reviewed and approved
console_and_observability: Add per-model dashboards: token cost, p50/p95 latency by region, error rate, quality metrics by prompt-set. Ensure trace ids are propagated for sampled requests. Create alert: p95 latency > 350ms for 10m or error rate > 2% for 5m.
post_launch_monitoring: Monitoring window: first 72 hours high-signal. Daily quality sweep for first 7 days against golden prompt set. Escalation path: SRE -> ModelOps -> PM -> Communications. Rollback condition: sustained quality regression (user-visible) or repeated SLO breach for 30m.
updates: 2026-03-10: Ticket created by Sofia with initial scope and locale list (en-US, es-ES, fr-FR, ja-JP)
2026-03-11: Benchmarks team requested clarifications on batch vs single-token latency targets; clarified in comments and updated benchmarks_requirements
2026-03-12: Docs team submitted draft localized quickstarts (see Drive link); PM provided feedback on cultural sensitivity examples
2026-03-13: Legal completed preliminary review; flagged potential export control for ja-JP variant pending further paperwork
2026-03-14: SRE validated canary pool and synthetic load tests passed p95 latency target in staging environment (logs attached in GH PR)
notes: Avoid launching all locales simultaneously in case of regional infra anomalies. Prefer staggered canary expansion and enable fast rollback aliases. Keep customers informed if locale support is beta or canary. Record any post-launch anomalies as linked incidents for learning.
follow_up_actions: Compile post-launch quality report at 72 hours and 7 days
If regression observed, convene triage with ModelOps + SRE within 1 hour
Schedule retrospective for launch week to capture process improvements
